description:
`LdpcCode::is_systematic` in `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/core.rs` returns `false` for every code; it does not inspect the code's structure.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `is_systematic` returns whether the code's layout places the message bits at identified codeword positions, covered by tests on a systematic and a non-systematic code.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its Rustdoc states the definition of systematic that it decides.
title: LdpcCode::is_systematic always returns false
